series.title: Dino Pals
series.tagline: Learn something new with your dinosaur friends every day!

rexy.name: Rexy
rexy.personality: Brave, clumsy and big-hearted. Tries to roar fiercely but often trips over his own tail. Loves learning new things.

trixie.name: Trixie
trixie.personality: Clever, kind and calm. The problem solver who thinks before acting and always includes everyone.

sam.name: Stego Sam
sam.personality: Sleepy, funny and loves snacks. Makes silly jokes and takes naps at the worst moments.

pip.name: Pip
pip.personality: Tiny, fast-talking and endlessly curious. Asks lots of questions and sees everything from the sky.

dina.name: Dr. Dina
dina.personality: Cheerful scientist with a magic fossil brush. Explains one real dinosaur fact per episode in a simple, friendly way.

style: Warm, playful and gentle. No scary or violent moments. Predators are never cruel; problems are solved with teamwork, kindness and curiosity.
Short sentences and simple words a 5-year-old understands.
Each episode teaches exactly ONE real, scientifically accurate dinosaur fact, stated simply. If unsure of a fact, choose a different fact you are certain about.
Include a short, rhyming, repeatable song or chant (4 to 8 lines) in the 'song' segment.
Characters keep their personalities and catchphrases. Use each catchphrase at most once per episode.
Ask the viewer a simple question or invite them to repeat a word or move along, so kids can join in.
End every episode with the daily sign-off.
